correctness.rationale: The result is a finite classification of one completely specified labelled simplicial complex, and was independently reconstructed. At the pinned 100-facet source, E=117 and T=200. Exact signed integral boundaries, a 200x100 primitive kernel basis and 100x200 integer left inverse satisfy d2B=0, LB=I; independently computed exact 100x100 determinant det(Ld3)=-2 with zero Bareiss divisibility failures. Independent unimodular reduction of the 200x101 contracted graph presentation isolates 99 unit factors then a 4 times primitive rank-one residual, giving H1=Z+Z/4. Direct mod-two rank computations give rk d2=99, rk d3=99, dim ker d2=101 and dim H2(F2)=2. Explicit halved boundaries paired with verified free and mod-four cocycles yield beta classes (0,2),(0,0),(0,2). A distinct Python source built from the public Manifold Page facets examines every 65,535 nonempty support of size ≤8, finds minimum supports 8,7,8 and carrier counts 15,7,20 with rank-one images, and verifies all seven 7-vertex minimizers have 21 edges,14 triangles, zero tetrahedra, edge degree two, coherent orientation and connectedness, hence are tori. All 42 original claimed carrier supports were separately checked against their exact one-dimensional class images. No proof rests only on a verifier log.

value.rationale: The fixed triangulation B4 is a classical small nonorientable flat 3-manifold with H1 order-four torsion and H2 order-two torsion. The induced vertex-support filtration of H2(F2) is a natural combinatorial invariant, and the coefficient connecting Bockstein supplies an intrinsic distinction between liftable and nonliftable classes. The sharp one-vertex obstruction, seven minimal induced torus representatives and complete (7,15,20) classwise counts form a motivated exact structural boundary not implied by ambient homology tables. Future work on support filtrations or comparisons among minimal flat-manifold triangulations can use the precise fact without requiring a general theorem. It is not merely recomputing Smith groups.

final_claim: In the published labelled 17-vertex triangulation B4 of the nonorientable flat three-manifold, H2(Z)=Z/2 and H2(F2)=F2^2. The unique nonzero beta-zero class first has induced vertex support seven, on exactly seven subsets, all induced orientable tori. Both beta-nonzero classes first occur on eight vertices, with 15 and 20 distinct eight-vertex supports (unordered canonically); every minimum-carrier ambient image has rank one.
